description: SHA-256 digests as printed by `cfr-inputs digests`. A folder's entry is the SHA-256 of its per-file SHA-256 hex digests, one per line in file order.

reproducible.description: Generated from the game rules alone, so they depend on no prior. Any build of this repository's source must reproduce them, and the generation workflow checks them before every solve.

port_evidence.description: Historical, and an input to nothing. The policy and the two-bit support file of the unpublished research implementation this package was ported from, and the prior they were solved on. That prior came from research discard-loop steps that are not in this repository, so these files cannot be regenerated here; the Rust port reproduced each of them byte for byte.
